Enhance Your Career Journey with POWERGRID!

POWERGRID is excited to announce the launch of its dedicated Mobile Recruitment App "PRAVESH" !!

 

To streamline and enhance your experience in applying for career opportunities, managing your applications, and staying updated with the latest recruitment news, we invite all prospective candidates to download and utilize the PRAVESH app.

Key Features of the PRAVESH App:

  • Real-Time Job Notifications: Receive instant notifications for new POWERGRID job openings.
  • Easy Application Submission: Apply for jobs directly from your mobile device.
  • Application Tracking: Monitor the status of your submitted applications seamlessly.
  • Document Management: Upload and manage your required documents securely.
  • Quick Access to Important Links: Find essential recruitment resources in one place.

Android Users

(You can search for POWERGRID PRAVESH on the respective app stores.)

We encourage all candidates to download the PRAVESH app immediately to ensure a smooth and timely application process for future POWERGRID recruitment drives. POWERGRID is committed to providing a seamless recruitment experience.

It is therefore clarified that POWERGRID does not offer out of turn employment to anybody. POWERGRID does not recruit anyone on the strength of his / her biodata/ resume. Any recruitment for Executive position in POWERGRID is widely advertised across India in English & Hindi National newspapers and employment news. Non-Executive positions are widely advertised in Regional level and also notified to Employment exchanges. Any direct recruitment for fixed tenure contractual engagements are also notified at State/ Regional level in Newspapers. All the detailed Recruitment advertisements mentioning the eligibility criteria for the advertised positions, including qualification, age, experience requirement, relaxation & concession to reserved categories, selection process etc. are notified on Career section of our website : www.powergrid.in. All online applications are hosted on the career section of our website only and all communication related to employment are sent through official post / official e-mail IDs only. POWERGRID has not authorized any organization/ individual to carry out any direct recruitment activity for regular / temporary employment under POWERGRID.

We therefore advise and caution all concerned not to fall prey to the unscrupulous agencies/ organizations/ individuals or fake advertisements/ notifications/ interview calls / job offers aiming at fleecing money. Please rely only on the information hosted on our official website: www.powergrid.in for any job/ career related information pertaining to POWERGRID. POWERGRID does not take any responsibility for candidates responding/ applying to any fake posts.

  Empanelment of Inquiry Officers   

हमें यह जानकारी मिली है कि विभिन्न जॉब पोर्टल/वेबसाइट/सोशल मीडिया पर पावरग्रिड के नाम से फर्जी भर्ती विज्ञापन प्रकाशित/प्रसारित किए जा रहे हैं, जिनमें उम्मीदवारों को आवेदन शुल्क के साथ विभिन्न पदों के लिए आवेदन करने की सलाह दी जा रही है। इसी प्रकार, पॉवरग्रिड के नाम और लोगो का इस्तेमाल करते हुए फर्जी इंटरव्यू कॉल लेटर/नियुक्ति प्रस्ताव ईमेल/हार्ड कॉपी के माध्यम से भी जारी किए जा रहे हैं और उम्मीदवारों से पॉवरग्रिड में चयन/रोजगार की सुविधा के लिए बैंक खातों में पैसे जमा करने को भी कहा जा रहा है। कई बार यह भी देखा गया है कि हमारे विज्ञापन से विकृत जानकारी/चुनिंदा जानकारी, जिसका अलग अर्थ निकाला जाता है, वेबसाइटों/सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम से प्रकाशित/प्रसारित की जा रही है।
